She had said repeatedly before that she was only in school this year to hang out with us. Friend1 is obviously currently preoccupied with famy stuff and not petty friend drama but she did tell Friend2 to fuck off as well. I spoke to her briefly about it before I messaged privately. I'm now being blamed by friends of Friend2 who were not in the groupchat for her leaving school. They are saying I helped bully her out of school. AITA? I'm beginning to think I was because of how strongly worded my message was.
